messages:
jamie: Quick sync: after the route-hash HMAC launch we need a clear rotation and SDK support plan. Running into customer asks about rotating keys without breaking attribution.
omar: Agreed. Current behavior: proxy signs route -> X-RD-Route-Hash + X-RD-Route-Key. Backend uses key to map hash->tenant. Rotation currently invalidates prior hashes immediately. Not great.
claire: We should support key-versioned HMAC where old keys remain readable for a grace window. Proposal: accept previous N keys for 30 days, surface deprecation in console telemetry for any hashed-attrib using old keys.
jamie: UX note: console should list active route-key versions per org and a "Rotate" button that creates new key vN+1 and schedules old key expiry with a configured grace period.
lucas: SDK considerations: clients must send the original route metadata only at ingest time (we don't want SDKs storing keys). SDKs should set header `X-RD-Route-Hmac-Version: vN` when preserve-route is enabled. Also we need to ensure SDKs don't compute HMACs locally.
rebecca: Right. Only server-side should HMAC. SDKs just opt-in flag `preserve_route_fallback` and forward `X-RD-Route` (plaintext) in TLS to proxy which does HMAC.
omar: That minimizes leakage risk. But some customers want self-hosted proxies that already HMAC on their edge. For private deploys we need a compatibility mode where proxies can accept pre-hashed route + key id. Need auth guard for that.
claire: Security: require pre-hashed uploads only when token scope includes `route:prehash`. And add telemetry to detect mismatches (hash computed with unknown key id).
jamie: Migration plan: 1) backend accepts multiple keys; 2) console exposes key UI and rotation API; 3) SDKs release opt-in helpers (py/ts/go) that set `preserve_route_fallback` but do not touch hashing; 4) docs and 30-day deprecation window for old direct-plaintext route passthrough.
lucas: For SDK release gating, propose we land SDK changes behind feature flag in SDK repo so customers can opt-in to preserve-route without immediate default change. Then coordinate with console enablement.
rebecca: Testing: add e2e that creates key v1, generates traffic, rotate to v2, continue traffic, confirm ledger aggregates for both keys and then for v2 only after grace period. Also test when a private proxy pre-hashes with unknown key -> event flagged.
omar: Metrics: emit route_key_version in kafka topic and in console traces. Add histogram for "age_of_key_at_use" to alert if old keys are used beyond grace.
jamie: Docs: update API spec for headers: `X-RD-Route`, `X-RD-Preserve-Route` (opt-in), `X-RD-Route-Key` (version id) and mention HMAC is server-side.
claire: Timeline estimate: backend + ledger change (2 sprints), console UI + audit logs (1 sprint), SDK patch releases (1 sprint with minor bumps) and rollout coordination. Total ~4 sprints with overlapping work.
lucas: I'll open PRs for ts-go helpers today; py already has a stub. Tag them with `rd/route-preserve` label.
rebecca: Release gating: use release-bot to schedule SDK releases only after console feature-flag is live in canary orgs.
jamie: Can we canary in 10% of orgs next week? Need assurance on billing dashboards.
ci-bot: canary pipeline queued for `route-preserve-canary` env.
rebecca: One more: update CSP/ingress docs for private deploys that accept pre-hashed headers so customers know the token scope needed.
jamie: Great. I'll send a short TL;DR to support/sales to prepare messaging. Follow-up meeting tomorrow 9am to lock dates. Please drop PR links here when opened.
release-bot: scheduled release window: 2024-09-02T07:00Z (canary), 2024-09-09T07:00Z (gradual prod)
